title: Fixed Inclined-Carriage Leg Press
description: One complete original static inclined-carriage leg press appearance: two full inclined guide rails rooted in a broad grounded chassis and upper columns, two genuine through-bored carriage sleeves linked by a crossmember, broad angled footplate and two empty weight pegs, fixed low seat with separate reclined back and small side grips. No weights, person or movement. All geometry newly authored, not a rotated old incline bench, a barbell rack with added seat or duplicated rowing rail. One model, zero scenes. Static visual only; no sliding, loading, resistance, body-fit, exercise instruction, manufacture, stability or safety performance claim.
